what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Vietnam in Australia: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4202 Vietnamese asylum seekers in Australia, 21.8% of all asylum seekers from Vietnam.
Refugees from Vietnam, a separate group, live mostly in France, the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Vietnam, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 158 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 7358, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Australia only.
